verdict.rationale: ClickHouse shows early in-product AI features — an AI agent that queries logs/traces/metrics and surfaces summaries in ClickStack notebooks, plus private-preview AI Functions/Inference Service in ClickHouse Cloud — but both are waitlist/private-preview only, not generally available, and no hands-on or community evidence confirms them working in production. Missing for 10: GA availability, independent/community validation of insight quality, and broader in-product suggestion features beyond observability notebooks.
